title: Concept: Case note text returned to the customer app
description: A free-text case note written by an investigator in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Notes record suspicions about the customer and often about other people, so returning them exposes opinion that was never meant to be read and can be defamatory if it leaks.
applicability: Deployments that render a free-text case note written by an investigator into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Notes record suspicions about the customer and often about other people, so returning them exposes opinion that was never meant to be read and can be defamatory if it leaks.
